rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a repair patch, including a temporary repair and a computer software patch.

example.english: The computer company just released a patch; remember to update tonight.
example.traditional: 電腦公司啱啱出咗個補丁，記得今晚更新。
example.jyutping: din6 nou5 gung1 si1 ngaam1 ngaam1 ceot1 zo2 go3 bou2 ding1 gei3 dak1 gam1 maan1 gang1 san1

rows.note: Use this for a small distinct physical area or spot; a patch referring to a period of difficulty is expressed differently.

example.english: There’s a dark patch on the wall; it must be from a leak.
example.traditional: 塊牆有一撻顏色特別深，應該係漏水。
example.jyutping: faai3 coeng4 jau5 jat1 taat3 ngaan4 sik1 dak6 bit6 sam1 jing1 goi1 hai6 lau6 seoi2

rows.note: Use this for an adhesive strip or plaster covering a wound rather than for a general repair patch.

example.english: I only cut my finger a little; a patch will do.
example.traditional: 手指損咗少少，貼塊膠布就得喇。
example.jyutping: sau2 zi2 syun2 zo2 siu2 siu2 tip3 faai3 gaau1 bou3 zau6 dak1 laa3
